name: Bicycle Crunch
cues: Lie face up with hands lightly behind your head
Lift your shoulders and both feet off the floor
Turn one shoulder toward the opposite knee as the other leg extends
Switch sides smoothly without pulling on your neck

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Contralateral checked by FK: thorax rot +18 (sternum x +0.066) while the left knee is in (hip 60 / knee 105) and the right leg is long (14/8 deg). The right hand moves to x -0.056 toward the left knee. Shoulders are off the mat (thorax flexion 32 deg), heels stay >= 0.21 m off the floor, and lumbar rot stays within +-4 deg.
